_doc: Fixed release pick-curve provenance. The adopted curve remains the ruler across weekly score updates. Current board/store/round identity is read fail-closed from expected_boot and the stamped board bundle. RE-ISSUED at the #271 adoption (owner word 2026-07-30). The curve was DERIVED on store 265f55d5; the adopted store is 6b9d00a7, which differs only by the three Addendum-12 backup-stream clears — measured value-neutral (0 board movers), so the curve was NOT re-derived for them and curve_source_store_md5 correctly records the derivation store, not the release store.

supersedes.note: Superseded by the #271 re-derivation, adopted on the owner word of 2026-07-30 ("30/7 rederivation for the label. Adopt."). Prior chain retained in git history.

split_note: THE PRICING SPLIT (owner ruling; RULEBOOK v2.1 law 4 G-MONO, amended 2026-07-28). The contract is re-issued because the ADOPTED CURVE'S DOMAIN changed, not its values: the national curve now covers picks 1-64 and every selection past 64 enters the pool, valued by position with order of selection carrying no value. There is no price for pick 70. Values over 1-64 are BYTE-IDENTICAL to the superseded artifact; pool_value is that artifact's own value at index 65. No curve was refitted. A re-issue is correct here precisely because the contract exists to stop the curve moving SILENTLY - this move is ruled, declared, and recorded below.
